item.title: Horny Goat Weed
item.description:
What it is: Horny goat weed (Epimedium) is a traditional Chinese herbal supplement containing icariin—a compound that works similarly to pharmaceutical PDE5 inhibitors by enhancing blood flow and nitric oxide production. Used for centuries to support sexual performance, modern research validates its mechanisms for erectile enhancement.

Benefits

Sexual Performance & Erectile Function

  • Improves erectile function and sexual arousal
  • Enhances sexual satisfaction
  • Increases sexual desire and libido
  • Natural alternative to pharmaceutical options
  • Works by improving blood flow

Blood Flow & Circulation

  • Enhances vasodilation and blood vessel widening
  • Improves nitric oxide production
  • Supports peripheral circulation
  • Cardiovascular function support

Energy & Stamina

  • May improve exercise endurance
  • Supports muscle energy and performance
  • Enhances overall vitality
  • Complements fitness efforts

Dosage

Erectile support: 500-750 mg as-needed or daily Enhanced: 750-1,000 mg daily or before activity Full: 1,000-1,500 mg daily Timing: 30-60 minutes before sexual activity or daily Duration: 2-4 weeks to assess effects

item.title: Tribulus Terrestris
item.description:
What it is: Tribulus terrestris is a traditional herbal containing saponin compounds that support testosterone production, sexual function, and athletic performance. Used in Ayurvedic and traditional medicine for millennia, modern research validates its testosterone and libido-supporting properties.

Benefits

Testosterone Support

  • May support healthy testosterone levels
  • Particularly effective when baseline is low
  • Supports sexual function through hormonal mechanism
  • Athletic performance improvement

Sexual Function & Libido

  • Improves sexual desire and arousal
  • Supports erectile function
  • Enhances sexual satisfaction
  • Works for both men and women

Athletic Performance

  • May improve muscle gains from training
  • Supports strength and power output
  • Enhances workout performance
  • Recovery support

Overall Vitality

  • May improve energy and mood
  • Supports general well-being
  • Complements healthy lifestyle

Dosage

Sexual support: 500-750 mg daily Enhanced: 750-1,000 mg daily Full: 1,000-1,500 mg daily Timing: With meals Duration: 4-8 weeks to assess effects
